cd /workspace/project && sed -i 's/    __slots__ = ("start", "accept", "closure", "table")/    __slots__ = ("start", "accept", "closure", "table", "_cache")/' src/eywa/regex.py && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from eywa.regex import compile_pattern
tests = [('','',{'' : True, 'a': False}), ('a*','aaa',{'' : True,'aaaa':True,'b':False}),
 ('[ab]*','abab',{'ab':True,'c':False}), ('a(b|)c',{'ac':True,'abc':True,'axc':False}),
 ('x*','xxxx',{'x':True}), ('[a-c]*','abc',{'d':False}), ('a**','aaa',{'':True})]
for src, s, cases in tests:
    for k, want in cases.items():
        got = compile_pattern(src).matches(k)
        assert got == want, (src, k, got, want)
print('regex ok')
" && python3 /workspace/tmp/t_match.py && for t in t_plan t_run t_ident t_ident2 t_pipe t_state t_invalid t_priority t_types t_pred t_result t_edge; do python3 /workspace/tmp/$t.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $t" || echo "FAIL $t"; done
